auth.intro: Kyerɛw wo adetɔn ne wo ka da biara, hu wo sika, na hu wɔn a wɔde wo ka.
auth.resetSent: Sɛ email no wɔ hɔ a, link bi reba.
auth.checkEmail: Hwɛ wo email na si wo akawnt no so dua, afei hyɛn mu.

auth.linkExpired: Link no akyɛ dodo anaasɛ wɔde adi dwuma dedaw. Kyerɛw wo email na nya foforo.

emailConfirm.title: Si wo email so dua
emailConfirm.why: Sɛ wo werɛ fi wo password a, yɛde ɔkwan a wobɛfa so asan aba no kɔ wo email so. Si so dua seesei na ama ayɛ adwuma.

emailConfirm.wrongCode: Code no nyɛ, anaasɛ akyɛ dodo. Hwɛ no yiye, anaa mia Soma bio.

emailConfirm.done: Wɔasi wo email so dua. Yɛda wo ase.

sync.title: Sɛnea ɛrekɔ
sync.warning: Nea wɔakora wɔ fon yi so betumi ayera sɛ wopopa browser no mu nneɛma anaa fon no yera a. Soma kɔ ntɛm bere a intanɛt bɛba.

members.title: Nnipa ne fon
members.intro: Fa onipa ne fon a ɔde yɛ adwuma ka ho. Adwumayɛfo kyerɛw adetɔn ne ɛka. Adwumayɛfo ntumi ntwa biribi mu, ntumi mfrɛ wura, na ntumi ntwe adwuma no nsɛm nyinaa. Ɔhwɛfo tumi siesie mfomso.
members.name: Onipa
members.empty: Wo nko ara na wowɔ hɔ. Fa obi ka ho bere a fon foforo bɛyɛ sotɔɔ no adwuma.

privacy.title: Kokoamsɛm ne nsɛm a wɔakora
privacy.body: Nnipa a wode wɔn ka ho hu adwuma yi. Azaria mmoa kuw no nso betumi abue de aboa wo; bere biara a wɔyɛ saa no wɔkyerɛw wɔ ase ha. Twe bi fi Nhyehyɛe mu. Adetɔn anaa ɛka a wɔakora wɔ fon yi so tena fon yi so kosi sɛ ɛbɛkɔ.

sale.title: Kyerɛw adetɔn
sale.body: Kyerɛw nea odetɔni no tɔe ne sika a woanya. Sɛ ɔda so de wo ka a, paw ne din na wɔahu ka no.

expense.title: Kyerɛw ɛka
expense.body: Da biara ka te sɛ dan ka ne lɔre ka yɛ ɛka. Nneɛma a wotɔe sɛ wobɛtɔn no yɛ nneɛma a woatɔ, wɔkora no soronko.

debt.title: Odetɔni no de ka
debt.body: Akatua a ɛba akyiri no tew ka a ɔde no so. Ɛnyɛ adetɔn foforo.

move.title: Yi sika kɔ baabi
move.body: Sɛ wode sika kɔ Mobile Money so a, akorae abien no na ɛsesa; wo adetɔn nsesa.

reverse.title: Siesie mfomso
reverse.body: Wura anaa ɔhwɛfo tumi twa biribi mu. Nea edi kan no tena hɔ, wɔhyɛ no nsow sɛ wɔatwa mu, na sika no san ba.

paper.title: Invoice ne risiti
paper.body: Invoice yɛ ka krataa ma odetɔni. Risiti kyerɛ sika a woanya. Twe biara sɛ PDF. Emu biara mfa adetɔn foforo nka ho.

documents.title: Invoice anaa risiti
documents.invoiceIntro: Eyi kyerɛw adetɔn no na ɛyɛ ka krataa a wubetumi atwe sɛ PDF. Ɛnyɛ adetɔn foforo.
documents.receiptIntro: Risiti kyerɛ sika a woanya. "Watua seesei" kyerɛw adetɔn no sɛ watua ne nyinaa. Anaa paw bi a ɛwɔ nwoma no mu dedaw.
documents.savedOffline: Wɔakora wɔ fon yi so. PDF no bɛyɛ krado bere a intanɛt bɛba na akɔ.
documents.noneToReceipt: Adetɔn anaa akatua biara nni ha ɛ.

errors.generic: Biribi ankɔ yiye. Yɛsrɛ wo san sɔ hwɛ.
errors.network: Intanɛt nni hɔ. Hwɛ wo intanɛt na san sɔ hwɛ.
errors.AZ_INVALID_INPUT: Nsɛm no bi nteɛ. Yɛsrɛ wo hwɛ na san sɔ hwɛ.
errors.AZ_CONTACT_REQUIRED: Paw odetɔni ma adetɔn a wontuaa ɛ.
errors.AZ_EXCEEDS_DEBT: Akatua no boro ka a odetɔni no de.
errors.AZ_NO_MONEY_RECEIVED: Sika biara amma eyi ho, enti risiti nni hɔ.
errors.AZ_SUPPORT_NOT_GRANTED: Wura no mmaa mmoafo kwan wɔ sotɔɔ yi ho, anaa bere no atwam.
errors.AZ_TRIAL_USED: Saa sotɔɔ yi de ne sɔhwɛ kwa no adi dwuma dedaw.
errors.AZ_DISCOUNT_INVALID: Koodu yi nyɛ papa, anaa ne bere atwam.
errors.AZ_DISCOUNT_EXISTS: Saa koodu no wɔ hɔ dedaw. Paw foforo.
errors.AZ_PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE: Akatua ntumi nkɔ so seesei. San sɔ hwɛ kakra akyi.

support.viewing: {name} mmoa nhwɛ. Wubetumi ahwɛ nko ara.
support.ownerIntro: Azaria mmoa kuw no betumi abue sotɔɔ yi de aboa wo. Ebinom betumi ahwɛ nko ara. Ebinom nso betumi de nsɛm aka ho anaa asiesie, na wɔde sie wɔ wɔn din mu, ɛnyɛ wo de. Bere biara a mmoa bue wo sotɔɔ no wɔkyerɛw wɔ ha.

events.edit_opened: Mmoa buee sotɔɔ yi yɛɛ nsakrae

support.discountsIntro: Yɛ koodu na fa tew Azaria Plus bo so ma obi. Koodu no yɛ adwuma bere bi anaa daa. Koodu a ɛyɛ 100% sɔ Plus a obiara ntua hwee.

support.discountInvalid: Hwɛ koodu no, ɔha mu nkyɛmu no ne anohyeto no.
support.paymentsOnHelp: Sotɔɔ biara bɛtua Azaria Plus ho ka. Sotɔɔ a entuaa ka no nni Plus.
support.paymentsOffHelp: Obiara ntua hwee. Sotɔɔ biara de biribiara di dwuma kwa, na obiara nsɛe ne sɔhwɛ bere.
support.paymentsConfirmOn: Efi seesei sotɔɔ biara bɛtua ka. Wɔn a wontuaa ka no bɛhwere Azaria Plus ntɛm ara. Nkontaabu da so yɛ kwa.
support.paymentsConfirmOff: Obiara rentumi ntua ka, na sotɔɔ biara benya biribiara kwa. Bere a wɔatua ho ka dedaw no kɔ so.
support.plansHelp: Bo foforo no fa akatua a edi hɔ ho. Bere a wɔatua ho ka dedaw no nsesa.

support.adminsIntro: Fa nnipa a wɔboa sotɔɔ ka ho, na paw nea obiara betumi ayɛ. Nsakrae yɛ adwuma ntɛm ara.
support.adminEmailHint: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔwɔ Azaria akawnt dedaw wɔ email yi so.

support.adminSuper: Superadmin: biribiara, na ɔhwɛ kuw no so

plus.title: Azaria Plus
plus.intro: Azaria Plus de mmoa foforo ka wo nkontaabuo ho. Adetɔn, ka ne aka a wokyerɛw no yɛ kwa daa, sɛ wowɔ Plus anaa wonni bi.
plus.graceUntil: Wo Plus bere no baa awiei {date}. Plus bɛyɛ adwuma nna kakra bio. Tua seesei na ɛnkɔ so.
plus.ended: Wo Plus bere no baa awiei {date}.
plus.off: Plus nyɛ adwuma wɔ saa sotɔɔ yi mu.
plus.trialStarted: Wo sɔhwɛ kwa no ahyɛ ase.
plus.codeHint: Sɛ obi a ɔwɔ Azaria maa wo koodu a, kyerɛw wɔ ha.
plus.payFree: Sɔ Plus, biribiara nni hɔ a wobɛtua
plus.payHint: Wobɛtua wɔ Paystack kratafa so de Mobile Money anaa kaad, na afei woasan aba ha.
plus.privacy: Paystack nsa bɛka wo email ne akatua no. Ɛrenhu wo nkrataa.
plus.ownerOnly: Sotɔɔ wura nko ara na ɔtumi tua Plus ho ka.
plus.paidNow: Plus reyɛ adwuma. Meda wo ase.
plus.returnPaid: Yɛn nsa aka akatua no. Plus reyɛ adwuma kɔsi {date}.
plus.returnPending: Yɛn nsa nkaa akatua no ɛ. Sɛ wopenee so wɔ wo fon so a, twɛn kakra na san hwɛ.
plus.returnFailed: Akatua no ankɔ so. Wubetumi asan asɔ ahwɛ.
plus.freeForNow: Azaria yɛ kwa seesei. Ɛho nhia sɛ wutua hwee, na biribiara abue ama wo sotɔɔ.
plus.freeForNowLater: Sɛ akatua fi ase a, wubehu bo no wɔ ha kan.
